title: The write path and the recovery path
subtitle: Three files per database, P, P-wal and P-journal. Click a stage for details.

steps.name: put / del / write(batch)
steps.role: A batch of changes from the caller

steps.name: DB
steps.role: Coordinates the log, the tree and checkpoints

steps.name: Wal::append + sync
steps.role: The commit point. Once this returns, the batch survives a crash

steps.name: BTree → BufferPool → Pager
steps.role: Applies the batch to pages in memory, then to P
details: BufferPool is LRU with pin counts and NO-STEAL, so no uncommitted page reaches P

steps.name: checkpoint
steps.role: Copies dirty pages to P atomically, then empties the log
details: Dirty pages to P-journal, header last, sync. The atomicity point
Dirty pages to P in place, sync

steps.name: P-journal complete?
steps.role: Replay it if complete, discard it if not

steps.name: load meta page
steps.role: Root, height, page count, checkpoint LSN

steps.name: redo P-wal
steps.role: Every record with LSN above the checkpoint LSN
